list.subtitle: Costing tasks after the director's resolution: deadline, line sign-offs and owner
list.caption: Requests in costing
list.select: Show the task for request {{number}} in the side panel

sheet.title: Costing for request {{number}}
sheet.subtitle: {{client}} · letter {{letter}} · costing due {{due}}
sheet.atDirector: Draft quote {{number}} is with the director for approval. Lines are locked until the director decides.
sheet.atDirectorVersion: Draft quote {{number}}, version {{version}}, is with the director for approval. Lines are locked until the director decides.
sheet.returned: The director returned the quote for rework: “{{comment}}”. Fix the lines and sign them off again.
sheet.rejected: The director rejected the quote. Costing is closed.
sheet.approved: The director approved the quote. Costing is locked.

notStarted.title: Costing has not started
notStarted.textLines: The request has {{count}} line(s). Move them into costing, then add lines and match them with the catalogue.
notStarted.textEmpty: The request has no lines, only text. Start costing and parse the request text into lines or add them manually.
notStarted.noRights: Costing can be started by an employee with full access to “Costing”.

sheet.rejectedComment: The director rejected the quote: “{{comment}}”. The costing is closed.

lines.title: Costing lines
lines.caption: Costing lines for request {{number}}
lines.stockMore: Bin and reserve — on the “Stock” screen
lines.supplierHintNoDate: min. order {{qty}} · price validity not set
lines.clientLabel: Unit client price excl. VAT for “{{name}}”
lines.costHidden: Purchase prices are visible to employees with access to cost
lines.empty: No lines yet. Add a line or parse the request text.

parse.title: AI parsing of the request text
parse.intro: AI will suggest lines from the request text. Nothing is saved until you tick the lines and press “Add selected”.
parse.textHint: You can edit it or paste your own text.
parse.pending: Parsing the text… This usually takes up to a minute.
parse.proposal: AI suggestion: tick the lines to add
parse.nothing: AI found no lines in this text. Add lines manually.
parse.failed: Parsing failed: {{reason}}. Add lines manually or try again.

reasons.ai_disabled: AI parsing is switched off in model settings
reasons.ai_budget_exceeded: the daily AI budget is used up

match.title: Match with catalogue
match.searchHint: Name, part number, manufacturer code or standard
match.nothing: Nothing found in the catalogue. Try other words.

hint.visas_missing: The button becomes active when every line is signed off: {{count}} without sign-off.
hint.not_draft: Costing has already gone to the director.
hint.rejected_client: The client rejected the quote — choose above: a new quote version or a lost request.

task.notInErp: the employee has not signed in yet
task.chatText: The project chat arrives with the “Chats” section (by the pilot). For now the team agrees in its work chat.
task.memo: A purchase outside the quote — a memo to the director.

empty.title: No request selected
empty.text: Select a row in the table — the task and sign-offs open here.

errors.visas_missing: Not every line is signed off.
errors.quote_not_draft: Costing is already with the director — lines are locked.
errors.line_incomplete: Fill in the purchase and client prices first.
errors.purchase_required: Enter the purchase price first: markup is calculated from it.
errors.client_price_below_cost: The client price is below the purchase price.
errors.cost_forbidden: Purchase prices and markup are edited by employees with access to cost.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.unavailable: ERP did not respond. Try again in a minute.
errors.deal_not_in_calculation: The request is closed or past costing.
errors.quote_not_rejected_by_client: A new version and a lost request are available once the client rejects the quote.

loadError.title: Costing did not load
loadError.text: Refresh the page or try again in a minute.

unavailable.title: ERP is not responding
unavailable.text: Costing data is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a minute.

forbidden.title: This section is not part of your role

notFound.title: The request is not among costing tasks

rejection.clientNoReason: The client rejected quote {{number}} (version {{version}}) without a reason.
rejection.choose: The request is back in costing. Decide what is next: recalculate and send a new quote version, or close the request as lost.
rejection.closed: The request is closed as lost. Its reservation is released.

lost.title: Lost request {{number}}
lost.hint: Required. Goes to the request log and to CRM.
lost.done: Request closed as lost, reservation released
